newsitem.title: UK: Lower prices failed to attract buyers on UK meals.
newsitem.headline: Lower prices failed to attract buyers on UK meals.

text.p: Lower prices on Thursday failed to attract buyers on the UK meals and feeds market.
Prices were as much as three stg down for high protein soymeal, but traders said buyers were well covered in the near positions and see no reason to move.
The only trade was reported was for A.D.M. rape meal bookings on the resale market which fetched 122 stg a tonne a couple of times.
On the rapemeal market the Erith mill was an unchanged seller while resellers were one stg down to unchanged.
Cargill was around one to two stg lower in both Liverpool and Hull.
Corn gluten feed pellets were one stg up to unchanged in Liverpool and unchanged in Portbury.
